response.sql: WITH status_stats AS (SELECT si.healtheval, AVG(sc.gbsize / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS avg_rate, AVG(sc.scancount) AS avg_count FROM scans AS sc JOIN sites AS si ON sc.zoneref = si.zoneregistry GROUP BY si.healtheval), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_rate) AS all_status_avg_rate FROM status_stats) SELECT AVG(s.avg_rate) AS average_rate, AVG(s.avg_count) AS average_count, AVG(s.avg_rate - b.all_status_avg_rate) AS average_rate_excess FROM status_stats AS s CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE s.avg_rate > b.all_status_avg_rate;
